verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions provides CI/CD workflows in GitHub Actions-compatible YAML, and Gitea integrates with external CI tools like Drone, Jenkins and Woodpecker. That makes recurring workflows plausible, but no item explicitly documents schedule or cron triggers, so the scheduling half of the story is only implied by the GitHub Actions compatibility claim. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduled/cron workflow triggers, details on managing recurring jobs, and hands-on or independent corroboration of scheduled runs.
